assessedBy: @architect (AIOX Spec Pipeline reassessment after official-source research and codebase review)

scope.notes: Cross-cuts widget configuration UI, protected local API, read-only browser rendering, field projections, persistence/migrations, security controls, and bilingual docs; estimated 11-20 implementation/test/doc files.

integration.notes: Adds a same-origin local browser-source page/read projection and depends on native OBS CEF, HTTPS certificate trust, and OBS page-permission behavior; no external Twitch/API integration or runtime service is added.

infrastructure.notes: Capability hashes and independently managed widget configuration require durable PostgreSQL schema and a real Prisma migration.

knowledge.notes: Uses existing stack, plus platform-specific OBS CEF behavior, OBS page permissions, and Chromium certificate trust guidance; exact bundled CEF trust behavior must be validated natively.

risk.notes: Widget capability leakage, stale broadcast data, UID/secret projection, local CA trust mismatch in embedded CEF, and resource cost of multiple browser sources require explicit tests and native acceptance.

flags: Architectural review required for widget-scoped read capability and shared projections.
Use real PostgreSQL migrations for capability persistence/revocation.
Validate local HTTPS CA trust in the exact OBS CEF runtime; never bypass validation or fall back to HTTP.
Measure eight active widgets at the two-second DOM SLA and inspect OBS resource behavior.
Set OBS Browser Source Page Permissions to None; do not use OBS bindings.
Keep FND-7 separate from FND-0 MVP baseline.
COMPLEX Spec Pipeline requires a second QA critique after revision.
